scenes.picture: Chidi standing in his kitchen, looking at a frying pan on the stove where plantains are burning black, thick dark smoke filling the air.
scenes.dialogue: Ah! My plantain don turn to charcoal!
scenes.caption: Chidi dey cook late night snack, but na fire insurance he suppose call.

scenes.picture: Chidi waving a towel frantically at the ceiling to clear the smoke, while soot falls from the ceiling onto his white t-shirt and face.
scenes.dialogue: Abeg smoke detector, calm down na! Na just small mistake!
scenes.caption: Kitchen don turn industrial chimney. Soot everywhere!

scenes.picture: Chidi trying to wipe black soot off his white t-shirt with a wet rag, but he only succeeds in smearing it into a massive dark stain.
scenes.dialogue: Jesus! Instead of clean, e dey spread like village gossip!
scenes.caption: Attempt to clean shirt results in abstract art disaster.

scenes.picture: Chidi sitting on his grey sofa, exhausted and frustrated, putting his soot-stained hands on his head, leaving black handprints on his face.
scenes.dialogue: Wetin I do God? Single life don tire me!
scenes.caption: Soot fingerprints now customized the living room sofa.

scenes.picture: Chidi looking at his white carpet which now has a giant black plantain oil stain right in the middle, surrounded by black footprints.
scenes.dialogue: Even my rug don join cult. E don black finish!
scenes.caption: The carpet don suffer humiliation wey pass exam failure.

scenes.picture: A Neat Naija attendant in a neat green uniform and glasses smiling confidently, holding cleaning equipment in Chidi's sparkling clean apartment.
scenes.dialogue: No worry Chidi, Neat Naija don take over. Sit down make you rest!
scenes.caption: Neat Naija don rescue another bachelor from disaster. Laundry, house, office, sofa and carpet cleaning. DM to book.
